screenshot: captured in-session via the browser pane; not persisted to screenshots/ (Firecrawl's screenshot format returned no payload for this host)
_operator_reference_only: This audit exists so the operator can see what the client has today. It is NEVER design DNA — the owl template is the sole source of layout and structure. See the anti-pattern lock in intake-from-web.
strengths: Genuinely good photography — real installed jobs, shot at night, not stock. Enough of it to carry a full site.
Deep, specific written content. Every service page has real body copy plus a 4–5 question FAQ, and the FAQs answer actual objections (daylight visibility, app control, install duration).
Clear differentiators are already written down: 24-hour maintenance response, the lease program, commercial-grade LEDs, hidden wiring.
Twelve city landing pages already exist, so the local-SEO intent is there.
weaknesses: The hero is unreadable. Light-blue and white headline text sits directly on a bright, busy house photo with no scrim — the three stacked headings lose against the roofline and the sunset.
No hierarchy in the hero: business name, service description and audience are three same-weight centred lines, so nothing leads.
No phone CTA above the fold beyond a plain-text number, and the header phone link points at /home-holiday rather than a tel: link.

Service-area URLs contain literal spaces (/lighting-company-service-area/permanent lighting alpharetta), which is a crawlable-URL defect and produces both encoded and unencoded duplicates in the sitemap.
Contact page lists 770-630-3653 while every other page lists 770-630-4653 — a NAP inconsistency that will split call attribution.
Homepage services are listed twice in two different formats, one after the other.
Gallery page is a wall of images with 'Button' as every link label.
No structured data, no llms.txt, no reviews, no trust signals of any kind.
reCAPTCHA challenges render inline on the page body, including on the homepage.
load_issues: All imagery is served at 1920w regardless of slot size — the homepage pulls a dozen full-width PNGs, several of which are photographs saved as PNG.
carry_forward: Reuse their photography — it is the strongest asset they have.
Reuse the FAQ text verbatim where it is good; it was written by someone who knows the trade.
Keep the service-area strategy but give the pages real slugs and real local copy.
